nameOrigin: of or relating to the occult or psychics

pokedexEntries.x: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

pokedexEntries.or: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

pokedexEntries.y: The eyeball patterns on the interior of its ears emit psychic energy. It keeps the patterns tightly covered because that power is too immense.

pokedexEntries.as: The eyeball patterns on the interior of its ears emit psychic energy. It keeps the patterns tightly covered because that power is too immense.

pokedexEntries.sw: Revealing the eyelike patterns on the insides of its ears will unleash its psychic powers. It normally keeps the patterns hidden, however.

pokedexEntries.sh: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It's when they're protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

pokedexEntries.sc: Though it has enough psychic power to blast away any opponent, Meowstic prefers to support its allies rather than attack.

pokedexEntries.vi: If Meowstic continuously emits its powerful psychic energy, it will damage its own body.

pokedexEntries.za: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
